title: Ore ga Ojou-sama Gakkou ni "Shomin Sample" Toshite Gets-Sareta Ken: Kujou-san no Doesu Soudan-Shitsu Anime-ban
justification: AniList 21492 (SPECIAL, 6 episode(s) from 2016-01-06) is AniDB 10729's special(s) S1-S6, aired 2016-01-06 to 2016-06-02. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 20771, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10729, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 64552 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S3 aired 2016-03-02, TMDB 64552 S0E3 2016-02-03; AniDB S4 aired 2016-04-02, TMDB 64552 S0E4 2016-02-04), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
